descriptors.definition: Passively managed funds focus on matching an underlying index return while maintaining minimal tracking error. The fund manager oversees regulatory compliances, continuously monitors performance, and executes research-backed wealth creation strategies.
exclusion: Active security selection designed to beat the market benchmark
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from actively managed funds by prioritizing index tracking and low tracking error over active alpha generation.

descriptors.concept_name: Role Of Fiis In Mutual Funds
descriptors.definition: Foreign Institutional Investors are large foreign entities that invest substantial capital into domestic equity markets and mutual funds. Their participation enhances corporate governance, increases market competition, and drives foreign currency inflows.
inclusion: Direct mutual fund unit purchases from issuers
Stock exchange purchases via registered brokers
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from domestic investors by their large foreign capital pools and rigorous due diligence standards on corporate governance.
